_comment: Site gazetteer: site_id -> name, district and WGS84 position. Gives FHIR
Location resources a `position` for the map layer.
Two families of sites are registered. The India stations (yam-* gan-* mit-*)
follow CPCB's National Water Quality Monitoring Programme locations on the
Yamuna and Ganga. The OAH pilot stations (site-*) cover the hackathon's
IoT telemetry and public-health envelopes carry a site_id but no coordinates,
so without this their Locations would be unmappable. Citizen-survey envelopes
DO carry coordinates and those always win over this file.
COORDINATES ARE APPROXIMATE and the readings in demo/timeseries/ are SYNTHETIC
- this is demonstration data shaped to be realistic, not observed measurement.
Replace with the real CPCB/state-PCB and OAH station feeds before presenting
any of it as authoritative. flow_km is distance downstream along that river
from the first monitored station, APPROXIMATE and for ordering stations in a
longitudinal profile. It is not a surveyed chainage.
